target: review of S67 (bus-api@v2 touch and G9)

decisions.question: S67 made bus-api@v2 G9's TopicRemoved carry no lineage, recovered by catchError with Lineage.root(). topology-dsl@v2's Errors and lineage lists the errors that carry none and omits TopicRemoved, and its first sentence can be read to give it the read's last lineage. When is topology-dsl aligned?

options.label: Insert a topology-dsl@v2 wording touch now, before H7e
options.consequence: One short hsdd-contract step; both contracts state the same lineage for TopicRemoved before any spec or plan step reads them.

options.label: Leave it for the final reconcile
options.consequence: No extra step, but reconcile does not author contract bodies, and the runtime's re-plan (H11) would read the two contracts disagreeing.

decisions.chosen: Insert a topology-dsl@v2 wording touch now, before H7e
decisions.why: The runtime phases that implement both contracts are re-planned at H11 and must read one rule. A contract body is hsdd-contract's to write, and topology-dsl@v2 is a draft authored in this intake, so the wording fix is a clarification of an unreleased version.
